description: This source file defines the PlacementFilterStrategyResolver class, which is responsible for resolving and managing placement filter strategies for grain types in the Orleans runtime system. It includes methods for retrieving strategies based on grain types, initializing filters, and ensuring their proper ordering and dependencies.

classes.name: PlacementFilterStrategyResolver
classes.description: Resolver class for determining placement filter strategies for grain types, handling caching, initialization, and ordering of filters.

methods.name: GetPlacementFilterStrategies
methods.description: Returns the array of placement filter strategies for a given grain type, using caching to avoid recomputation.

methods.name: GetPlacementFilterStrategyInternal
